name: @arena/knowledge-capture
description: Arena domain-knowledge capture lattice (Work Order C008; issue #115; spec/expert-environment-session.md EES1.0 'Knowledge capture'). The four knowledge tiers (task-specific guidance / scoped reusable knowledge / candidate domain rule / verified domain constraint) as a typed lattice over the C006 KnowledgeArtifact vocabulary with structured scope declarations (task/case/domain/jurisdiction), evidence refs, validation state and rights/consent statements. NO-SILENT-PROMOTION is enforced STRUCTURALLY (architecture-lock rule 31): tier promotion is an explicit append-only operation requiring granted rights, provenance, evidence, validation (for the verified tier) and at most one scope-rank widening per step — task-specific advice can never surface as universal knowledge (the overgeneralization wall is machine-checked and tested). Ships the KnowledgePatch: the scoped, rights-carrying, evidence-backed statement A019/A020 consume as a LEARNING CANDIDATE ONLY.
